type: Frontend E2E verification of invoice-editor line-item typing bug fix + full invoice issuance flow
summary: Verified end-to-end that the reported bug is FIXED. Using REAL keyboard typing (page.keyboard.type, not element.value injection): (1) On /invoices/new with no product selected in line 0, description accepted 'Παροχή υπηρεσιών συμβούλου' as typed; qty=3, unitPrice=100, discount=10 all registered; Σύνολα panel updated to Καθαρή 270,00 € / ΦΠΑ 24% 64,80 € / Πληρωτέο 334,80 € (math correct: 3×100×0.9=270). (2) Added a second line via 'Προσθήκη γραμμής' — both lines independently accept typing (line0 desc/qty/price='Υπηρεσία Α'/2/50, line1 desc/qty/price='Υπηρεσία Β'/1/200). (3) Selected customer 'ALELI ΙΔΙΩΤΙΚΗ ΚΕΦΑΛΑΙΟΥΧΙΚΗ ΕΤΑΙΡΕΙΑ · 801454624' via combobox AFTER typing line values — all typed line values PRESERVED (line0 desc/price='Υπηρεσία Α'/50, line1 desc='Υπηρεσία Β'). This directly addresses the previously flagged concern (iter37 minor) about applySeries eating in-progress input. (4) Clicked 'Έκδοση παραστατικού' — editor-confirm-issue-dialog appeared with Επιχείρηση='Δήμος Παπαδόπουλος & ΣΙΑ Ε.Ε.', Παραστατικό='ΤΠ · ΤΠ · επόμενος αριθμός κατά την έκδοση', Πελάτης='ALELI ΙΔΙΩΤΙΚΗ ΚΕΦΑΛΑΙΟΥΧΙΚΗ ΕΤΑΙΡΕΙΑ', Πληρωτέο='372,00 €' (2×50 + 1×200 = 300 net + 72 ΦΠΑ = 372, correct). Closed via -back cleanly. (5) Save-as-draft on fresh /invoices/new: without customer shows clear inline invoice-error-customerId 'Επιλέξτε πελάτη…', line data preserved; with customer selected, blocked by fiscal-period lock error 'Η περίοδος 2026-09 είναι κλειδωμένη…' (from prior test data), line data still preserved — acceptable per task spec. (6) Hydration guard: on page load with 1.5s settle, buttons show 'Έκδοση παραστατικού' and 'Αποθήκευση ως πρόχειρο' (NOT 'Προετοιμασία…'), disabled attribute is null → enabled correctly. (7) Regression: Παρατηρήσεις textarea accepts typing ('Ελέγχος σημειώσεων'); issueDate/dueDate inputs render with values 2026-09-14 / 2026-10-14 and remain editable.
